jobs.occupation: Data Context Engineer (f/m/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
What if your work could not only influence but also significantly accelerate corporate management and decision-making? If you lay the crucial foundations so that our agentic systems can scale reliably and thus become a real productivity booster for our company?
That is precisely your mission. We are already well advanced in the field of AI and agentic systems. But to make the leap from intelligent prototypes to autonomously acting, productive systems, we must solve the decisive challenge: **scaling the data context.**As a Data Context Engineer (f/m/d), you are the key player to master this challenge. Building on our state-of-the-art Data Mesh, you will industrialize the bridge to our intelligent agents. Your mission is to create the structure, knowledge, and reliability in the data foundation so that our AI vision can become a reality - combining data engineering with agentic engineering to make enterprise context, tools, and governance scalable for AI systems.What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of Siemens

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by

- You will industrialize the knowledge base of the AI: You design and implement robust, scalable architectures for context, memory, and tool integration, which enable our agents to reliably execute complex, multi-stage tasks across multi-agent orchestration, MCP, and A2A-based interaction patterns.- You will act as an internal consultant and sparring partner: You will actively advise our AI lab and the business departments, analyze where missing context limits the performance of our agents, and develop targeted solutions at the data level and in enterprise workflow integrations such as Google Workspace and related SDKs.- You will function as an interface between the AI lab and the data world: You will translate the demanding requirements of our AI researchers into stable, scalable data architectures and thus ensure a smooth flow of information with a strong focus on AI governance and model risk management.- You will build the semantic backbone of our Data Mesh: You will model highly networked data and knowledge models using dbt, the dbt Semantic Layer, Python, and Knowledge Graphs. Based on this, you will develop semantic views in Snowflake and leverage Snowflake Intelligence and Cortex Analyst to create a machine-readable knowledge layer that serves as a "single source of truth" for our AI.- You will define the gold standard for AI data quality: You will establish sophisticated evaluation and benchmark processes to systematically ensure the consistency, accuracy, and trustworthiness of the information on which our agents operate including LLM tracing, lineage, data catalog integration, and internal AI benchmarks.

This is how you'll win us over

- Education- Degree in (Business) Informatics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a comparable discipline.
- Experience & Skills- 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, AI, or related fields, with a strong understanding of building solutions beyond prototypes.- Solid expertise in Python, SQL, data modeling, dbt, and Snowflake.- Practical experience with LLMs, agentic systems, and AI application development; GraphRAG experience is a plus.- Knowledge of Data Governance, Master Data Management, and vector databases is an advantage.- Strong analytical skills with the ability to solve complex technical challenges and communicate solutions effectively to diverse stakeholders.
- Ways of working- Thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and agile environment.- Take ownership and work effectively both independently and within cross-functional teams.- Bring a strong growth mindset, curiosity, and willingness to continuously learn.- Act as an enabler, creating scalable solutions that increase team productivity and business impact.- Combine hands-on execution with a structured, solution-oriented approach.
- Languages- Very good German and English skills round off your profile.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.

jobs.occupation: Credit Analyst for Financial Institutions and Non-Bank Financial Institutions (m/f/d)* (Underwriter (Versicherung))
jobs.description:
Go beyond and create global impact: At Munich Re, we're proud to be one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, primary insurance, and insurance-related risk solutions. Our group is made up of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, along with our asset management company, MEAG. We operate globally and are active in all lines of the insurance business.
Since our founding in 1880, we've built a reputation for unrivalled risk-related expertise and a solid financial foundation. We use our strengths to support our clients' business goals and drive technological progress. We're also at the forefront of developing coverage for emerging risks, from rocket launches and renewable energy to cyber threats and artificial intelligence.
With around 44,000 people worldwide, our group's corporate culture is defined by performance, mutual respect, and trust. All this makes us an attractive employer providing global career development opportunities and prospects.
Munich Re is writing business mainly with global banks by insuring credit risks originated by the banks - either on single risk basis (Global Credit Solutions - GCS) or on the basis of structured portfolio transactions (Structured Portfolio Solutions - SPS). Your role as Credit Analyst (Risk Underwriter) is to support the teams by conducting risk analyses of financial institutions and sovereigns, from emerging markets in particular, as well as assessing complex financing transactions in the field of export trade finance, and making the necessary preparations for independent credit decisions in conjunction with the Client Relationship & Risk Manager (CRRM).
Your Job

- Analysis of creditworthiness of banks and non-bank financial institutions as well as evaluation of complex financing structures in the field of trade finance
- Determination of maximum risk appetite for individual banks and banking sectors on country-level
- Assessment of country risks in the context of financing transactions of sovereigns
- Prepare internal credit applications, making informed recommendations and providing internal stakeholders and clients with reasoned explanations for decisions
- Monitoring and steering the existing financial institutions portfolio with a global scope; identification of significant risks at an early stage and initiating appropriate risk measures
- Developing and enhancing existing tools and credit risk management systems
- Cooperate closely with a deal team as well as involvement in direct client contacts
- Participate in regular client meetings to discuss transactions, portfolio developments and relevant market and credit developments.
- Take initiative with regard to the examination and development of strategic growth initiatives and new business opportunities
- Support efforts to enhance existing tools, credit risk management systems and processes

Your Profile

- University / Master degree, preferably in business or economics or with a scientific focus; additional qualifications such as CFA or equivalent are a strong advantage
- At least 7 years' professional experience in the credit analysis of banks and non-bank financial institutions (preferably in emerging markets)
- Relevant product knowledge in trade finance and general financing transactions of banks and NBFIs
- Good knowledge of sovereign risk analysis
- In-depth knowledge of credit risk management in banks, including development finance/multilateral institutions, and keen interest in economic, political, and regulatory topics
- Excellent analytical skills combined with a pronounced risk awareness and sense of responsibility, independent and result-oriented working style, ability to justify decisions in a clear and comprehensible manner
- Proficient use of MS-Office (especially Excel and Power BI) and interest in AI supported analysis
- Strong team player and confident demeanour, able to contribute in a dynamic and collaborative environment
- Very good written and verbal command of English; additional business-relevant language skills are an advantage

Application Instructions
Please apply through our online portal and upload your CV, as well as your academic reference letters, including school certificates, graduation certificates and transcripts of record for any degrees. If applicable, please also submit reference letters from any previous employers or certificates from any other qualifications you may have. We recommend writing a cover letter to tell us more about why the position and Munich Re is of interest to you.
About us
As the world's leading reinsurance company with more than 16,000 employees at over 50 locations, Munich Re introduces a paradigm shift in the way you think about insurance. By turning uncertainty into a manageable risk we enable fundamental change. Join us working on topics today that will concern society tomorrow, whether that be climate change, major construction projects, medical risk assessment or even space travel.
Together we embrace a culture where multiskilled teams dare to think big. We create the new and the different for our clients and cultivate innovation.
Sounds like you? Push boundaries with us and be part of Munich Re.
Our employees are our greatest strength. That's why we offer them a wide range of benefits. You can find some examples below.
Unlock your potential

- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: we embrace the power of differences and are convinced that diversity fosters innovation and resilience and enables us to act braver and better.
- Continuous Learning: we believe that continuous learning is a key differentiator and critical for building new skills and accelerating growth.
- Career Mobility: we actively support career mobility, and our strong global and regional presence offers a wealth of career growth opportunities for you.

Rewards & Recognition

- Retirement provision: state of the art in-house pension solutions.
- Work-life balance: promoting the compatibility of family and work in addition to overall work-life balance.
- Health management: focus on your physical and mental health far beyond legal requirements.
- Hybrid working: living the best of both worlds - we offer you a very flexible approach as well as the opportunity to work from abroad on an occasional basis.
- Munich Re not only stands for fairness with regard to its clients; it is also an equal opportunities employer. Severely disabled candidates will also be prioritized, if equally qualified.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student - Immunotherapy/Optical CRISPR Screens/Spatial Transcriptomics (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network. 

Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.

For our Junior Research Group Pediatric Immuno-Oncology (led by Dr. Dr. Franziska Blaeschke) we are seeking, starting in January 2027, a PhD Student - Immunotherapy/Optical CRISPR Screens/Spatial Transcriptomics.

Our group uses advanced genetic engineering and high-throughput CRISPR screens to improve CAR- and TCR-based immunotherapies. This project explores how highly effective anti-tumor immune cells can be identified and enhanced to better fight cancer. By combining functional screening (e.g., genome-wide CRISPR screens), cutting-edge cell engineering (e.g., AAV-based knockins, base editing), and innovative imaging and sequencing technologies (e.g., NIS-seq, spatial transcriptomics/proteomics), we aim to uncover key features of the most powerful anti-tumor T cells (“elite” immune cells) and translate these insights into next-generation immunotherapies.
The work will include a large variety of experimental methods and models (in vitro and in vivo), in close collaboration with the groups of Prof. Dr. Adelheid Cerwenka (Department of Immunobiochemistry, Medical Faculty Mannheim of Heidelberg University), Prof. Dr. Joachim Spatz (Department of Cellular Biophysics, Max Planck Institute), Prof. Dr. Nina Papavasiliou (Division of Immune Diversity, DKFZ), Prof. Dr. Michael Platten (Clinical Cooperation Unit Neuroimmunology and Brain Tumor Immunology at DKFZ and Department of Neurology at the University Medical Center Mannheim), and Dr. Vibor Laketa (Infectious Diseases Imaging Platform, UKHD). Together, the project seeks to define and build next-generation immune cells with enhanced therapeutic potential.

Your Tasks

- Establishing new experimental protocols and optimizing technologies (e.g., NIS-seq, spatial CRISPR screens)
- Working on computational approaches to read out CRISPR screens, imaging and sequencing data (e.g., spatial transcriptomics/proteomics)
- Designing and performing complex experiments involving a large number of methods (e.g., cloning, CRISPR/Cas9, viral transduction, AAV generation, flow cytometry, microfluidics systems, next-generation sequencing, microscopy, xenograft and syngeneic models, primary cell culture, functional analyses such as cytokine release, proliferation, cytotoxicity assays etc.)
- Staying up to date with scientific literaturePresenting your research on a regular basis within the group, the DKFZ/KiTZ and externally
- Preparing grants, patents, and publications

Your Profile

- Completed studies with a diploma or master's degree in biology, bioengineering, biomedical science, biochemistry, bioinformatics, or other relevant fields
- Previous experience in coding and single-cell or spatial transcriptomics/proteomics is preferred
- Excellent communication skills and social competence
- Team player who is motivated to closely work with collaboration partners within the institute and beyond
- Strong laboratory and writing skills
- Willingness to lead and perform in vivo studies
- Proficiency in English (written and spoken)
- High level of enthusiasm, motivation, and responsibility
- Deep interest in planning, conducting, and analyzing experiments in a systematic and independent way
- Effective time management and organizational skills

Please submit a motivation letter (1 page) and a CV (including a publication list and contact information of two references) in one single PDF.

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- Access to international research networks
- Doctoral salary with the usual social benefits
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Possibility of part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted training and mentoring through the DKFZ International PhD Program and DKFZ Career Service
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Contact:

Dr. Franziska Blaeschke
Phone: +49 (0)6221/42-1370

​Duration: The position is initially limited to 3 years.

Application Deadline: October 15, 2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.

We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.

About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support our Overall Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) Design Team**,** Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

** Eurodrone Overall RPAS Design Chief Engineer (d/f/m)**

Are you passionate about shaping the future of Airbus Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) products? Join our Overall Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) Design Team for Eurodrone and contribute your skills and enthusiasm to our dynamic Chief Engineering Organization. As such, execute overall design and steering activities to ensure a consistent RPAS design and integration across all functions and through the entire lifecycle, compliant with top level system requirements. Steer the flight chain (Ground Safety Critical Control Station, Flight Management System, Safe Flight and Landing System) as an integral part of the overall RPAS design and ensure the compliance with all overall RPAS design activities.

** Your location**

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

** Our Benefits for You**

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

** Your tasks and responsibilities**

- Optimize design for the overall RPAS and ensure integration of all level 1 sub-products.
- Perform trades & candidate aircraft configurations associated to RPA and flight chain architectures & requirements.
- Coordinate the flight chain design (GSCCS, FMCS, FMAIS, SFLS), ensuring consistent safety-critical design.
- Ensure RPA compliance with airworthiness and safety, environmental conditions, design maturity, security and RPAS airport operations at the aircraft level.
- Control the RPA and flight chain technical baseline and design changes, Assessing the consequences of technical Change Requests on overall RPAS architecture and aircraft configuration, ensuring configuration maturity aligns with programme milestones and safety objectives.
- Lead the definition of the certification and qualification roadmap for in close alignment with customer and regulatory bodies.
- Integrate and coordinate Flight Physics activities (performance, HQ, loads) and drive flight chain consistent solutions into the overall configuration.
- Achieving the handling quality requirements for the RPAS failure free and for failure cases.
- Secure the project schedule to achieve the program milestones, align technical directives to all design teams, ensuring end to end readiness.
- Ensure integration and verification plans and activities to achieve final certification and qualification; from analysis and simulation through systems testing and completed at Flight Test Level.

If you are ready to take on this exciting challenge and make a significant impact on the future of Airbus UAV products, we encourage you to apply.

** Desired skills and qualifications**

- Master of Science in Aerospace Engineering or equivalent.
- Significant Engineering experience > 8 years in related area.
- You have excellent leadership skills and profound experience in leading teams.
- Deep knowledge of Flight Dynamics, Flight Mechanics and Flight Control Laws.
- Extensive experience in the development of Flight Control Systems.
- Experience in the development of DAL-A software.
- Knowledge in Overall Aircraft Design, Overall System Design and Overall Physical Design.
- Operational knowledge on UAS or aircraft Operation, in particular Automatic Take Off and Landing.
- Proven track record in project management and technical management.
- Excellent coordination and communication skills.
- Goal-oriented mind set and good analytical skills.
- Very strong team player.
- Exceptional English language skills (Negotiation Level).

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

**Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

#MYCYM**

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Founding CTO | Co-Founder Opportunity (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
About HeyGermany

Germany urgently needs international talent. Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.

HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on, product-minded Founding CTO with the ambition to build HeyGermany as a co-founder. You will take ownership of our technology and play a leading role in product development. You will work closely with the Founder & CEO on company strategy, product direction and execution. We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. Your challenge will be to turn this foundation into a scalable technology platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many.

What You’ll Do

- Own our technology strategy and architecture and help shape our product strategy and roadmap.
- Design and build scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.
- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital products.
- Stay hands-on across the stack and make key decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure.
- Develop our AI capabilities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction and workflow automation.
- Work directly with users, employers and domain experts. As we grow, you will build and lead HeyGermany’s product and engineering team.

What We’re Looking For

- We care less about your current title than about what you have built and the level of ownership you are ready to take.
- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong hands-on development skills.
- A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software
- Engineering or a closely related technical discipline. A Master’s degree is preferred.
- A proven track record of shipping a real product end-to-end in a leading technical role, for example as a founder, founding engineer, startup CTO or technical lead.
- Strong experience with a modern web stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in your day-to-day work.
- Strong product judgment and the ability to turn customer and business problems into pragmatic product and technical decisions.
- The ability to move fast in an early-stage environment and make good trade-offs between speed, quality and scalability.
- A founder mindset and strong connection to our mission. You want real ownership, are comfortable with the ambiguity of a pre-seed company and care about the business beyond technology.
- Strong English communication skills are required. German is a plus.
- Experience with document intelligence/OCR, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, HR Tech, Global
- Mobility or regulated/GDPR-sensitive products is valuable, but not required.

What We Offer

- €50,000–€65,000 annual base salary, depending on experience, plus meaningful equity reflecting the founder-level ownership of the role.
- The opportunity to become a true co-founder, with long-term ownership of technology and meaningful participation in the company’s upside.
- Founder-level influence over product, technology and company strategy, with the opportunity to build our architecture and future engineering organisation from the ground up.
- A live product, early traction, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. We are currently in conversations with investors for our next stage of growth.
- The opportunity to work on a problem with tangible social and economic impact: helping international professionals access jobs that match their qualifications while helping employers access talent they urgently need.

We believe professional opportunities should be determined by people’s skills, not by their ability to navigate bureaucracy. If this is a company you would like to help build, we would like to hear from you.

Send one thing you've built that you're proud of, and tell us why this mission matters to you.

katharina@hey-germany.com

jobs.description:
As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!
